pages.title: Attract, Repel, Warp
pages.text: A plain ruin affects a 13x1x13 region on its own layer. Sneak-use empty-handed to switch attraction and repulsion; the screen controls player targeting. A player holding a Miniature Ruin is immune. Link opposite states of the same type with the Instrument wrench to make the attracting end warp centre targets one-way.

pages.title: Stabilized Ruin
pages.text: The stabilized form adds a 54-slot cache, 20-slot allow/deny filter, configurable region, and period. Normal state collects dropped items; reversed state sends the cache toward air positions or item containers. Linked opposite ends share inventory.

pages.title: Entangled Stabilized
pages.text: The entangled form runs normal and reversed sides in parallel over one 54-slot cache. Each side retains its own region, period, preview, enabled state, faces, and filter. Use the arrow buttons to select the side being edited.

pages.title: Advanced Stabilized
pages.text: The advanced form is not Xianqiao-bound; it schedules regional containers directly. Normal state extracts acceptable stacks, while reversed state distributes its inventory to targets. Rejected remainder stays local and never becomes a world drop.

pages.title: Advanced Entangled
pages.text: This form combines two advanced schedulers over one 54-slot cache. Craft it directly or convert an Advanced Stabilized Ruin. Each side still keeps separate filter, region, period, preview, enabled state, and faces.

pages.title: Scheduling Order
pages.text: Advanced pages choose skip or forced access, per-item or per-stack distribution, and near-first or far-first order. The working region exactly matches its preview. Every position and enabled face is a separate target; all faces disabled means no container interaction.

pages.title: Reinforce Reversed Output
pages.text: All four stabilized machines accept one reinforcement plugin. It multiplies only the number of reversed output groups attempted per round by 4, 16, or 256. Attempts stop as soon as the cache empties or every target rejects. The plain ruin has no plugin slot.

pages.title: Reading the Preview
pages.text: Six-face previews preserve each face direction. White is the ordinary interactable face, and reversed state uses bright white. Boundary and offset match the server region exactly; a missing texture or magenta-black face is never a valid state.
